description: This file is a shell script testing the compatibility of different Git object formats (SHA-1 and SHA-256). It initializes repositories with various objects (commits, trees, tags, blobs), signs some of them with GPG, creates tags and branches, and performs comparisons to verify object integrity and compatibility between different hash formats. The script appears to test how Git handles objects across different hashing algorithms and object formats.

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Defines hash function compatibility mappings between sha1 and sha256.

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for a hello file given a hash type.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for a tree given a hash type.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for a commit given a hash type.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for a second commit given a hash type.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes GPG signatures from a commit based on the specified hash type.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes GPG signatures from a tag based on storage and delete parameters.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Compares the object IDs and properties for objects across repositories with different hash formats to verify consistency in type, size, content, and pretty-printed content.
